title: „Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" – Verkehrssicherheits-Aktionstag zum Schulanfang in der STATION Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin held a road safety action day for second-graders at STATION Berlin ahead of the new school year, with appeals to drivers to show consideration near schools. Police are running around 1,200 traffic and prevention operations near schools during the first two school weeks.
